crucialFeats: At the age of one, he ruled his own planet; at six, he destroyed it.
Defeated the Justice League and Teen Titans simultaneously.
Keeps trophies from defeated Supermen across dimensions.
Absorbs the Heart of Darkness, becoming even more powerful.
Erases opponents' atoms with a single gesture.

dossier.advantage: Absolute manipulation of dimensions and souls. Trigon is not just a physical threat - he is a metaphysical infection that seizes control over the opponent's very essence.
dossier.mentality: Pure evil and sadistic narcissism. He does not fight to survive, but for total domination and humiliation of all life.
dossier.quote: Your world is mine. Your souls are my toys. Trigon is coming!
dossier.style: Magical domination and chaos projection. He uses infernal power to destroy minds and bodies before enemies can comprehend the scale of the threat.

fighterA.name: Trigon

powers: Reality manipulation, infernal magic, soul absorption, and near-unbounded energy projection.
tools: Ability to create demon armies and corrupt heroes.
Dimensional control, allowing attacks from points beyond enemy perception.
weaknesses: Dependence on rituals and dimensional gates for full manifestation in some realms.
Arrogance that can make him underestimate small, precise attacks.

crucialFeats: Devours entire planets to sustain his existence.
Survived the Big Bang of the previous universe.
Overwhelms cosmic entities through sheer presence.
Wields the Power Cosmic, allowing broad manipulation of matter and energy.

dossier.advantage: Power Cosmic and existential scale. Galactus does not fight - he executes a consumption process. He controls the universe's fundamental forces at an unimaginable level.
dossier.mentality: An amoral force of nature. He does not kill from hatred, but from hunger. He sees planets and gods as fuel required to maintain cosmic balance.
dossier.quote: I am not a god. I am not a monster. I am Galactus. I am inevitability.
dossier.style: Cosmic manipulation and erasure. He uses the Power Cosmic to break matter to atoms and consume all available energy in a given sphere.

fighterB.name: Galactus

powers: Power Cosmic, and universal-scale manipulation of matter, energy, and time.
tools: Ultimate Nullifier (in extreme cases) - a weapon capable of destroying entire continuums.
Ability to create heralds who carry out his will in lower dimensions.
weaknesses: Hunger - his power drops drastically when he does not consume planets.
Complex technological processes required for efficient consumption.

battle-dynamics.label: Clash in the Material Realm
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Galactus operates in his default environment. The Power Cosmic keeps Trigon's magic under control.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Trigon loses influence over the physical world. Galactus begins neutralizing the infernal anomaly.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Energy consumption. Galactus devours Trigon's essence, treating him as exceptionally dense fuel.
battle-dynamics.analysis: In the physical sphere, Galactus's Power Cosmic holds a natural advantage over Trigon's magic.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: Galactus enters Trigon's dimension. Here, the laws of physics are dictated by the infernal ruler's will.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: The Power Cosmic starts to fail in the face of infinite darkness. Trigon infects Galactus's essence.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Absolution of shadow. Trigon takes control of Galactus, making him his most powerful servant.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: At the heart of his own realm, Trigon is almost impossible to defeat, even for Galactus.

fight-simulation.label: Cosmic Neutralization
fight-simulation.opening: Galactus uses the Power Cosmic to impose structure on Trigon's dimension.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Trigon tries to tear Galactus apart from within by attacking his cosmic consciousness.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Galactus releases an energy wave that burns infernal influence out of the local continuum.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Galactus strikes with pure Power Cosmic energy, ignoring Trigon's barriers.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Two infinities collide, destroying nearby galaxies.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Galactus begins consuming the opponent's dark energy.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Trigon loses stability in the material world.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Galactus erases Trigon's trace from reality.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Trigon is forced back to his own realm.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Galactus enters Trigon's domain, unknowingly giving up initiative.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: Trigon begins corrupting the Power Cosmic, turning it into a tool of torture.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Galactus desperately tries to leave the dimension.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Trigon triumphs, becoming master of the cosmic devourer.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: The universe falls into eternal darkness.

final-summary.line_1: This is a clash of ultimate extremes: Galactus's physical consumption versus Trigon's spiritual corruption.
final-summary.line_2: The outcome depends almost entirely on location and on who imposes their reality rules first.
final-summary.line_3: In the material world Galactus is unstoppable, but in the Hell Domain he becomes the victim.

tactical-board.lane: The winner must control the dimension where the fight takes place.
tactical-board.subtitle: Devourer versus Demon

verdict-matrix.subtitle: Verdict depends on battlefield domain
verdict-matrix.case_1: Galactus 8/10. The Power Cosmic gives Galactus complete control over matter and energy. In a physical sphere, Trigon is powerful, but Galactus has the tools to neutralize supernatural anomalies and can simply consume Trigon's energy.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Trigon 9/10. In his own dimension, Trigon is absolute. By entering it, Galactus loses grounding in the laws of physics that fuel his Power Cosmic. Trigon can infect Galactus's soul and seize his infinite power.

x-factor.implikacja: Galactus wants to neutralize the threat. Trigon wants to seize it.
x-factor.mechanika: The Power Cosmic is science elevated to divinity. Trigon's magic is will that destroys science.
x-factor.psychologia: Galactus is hungry, but Trigon is evil. That difference in motive makes Trigon more unpredictable.
